description: Decision request accepted by bass decide. JSON Schema cannot express these bass rules. An encoding longer than 1048576 bytes: bass rejects it before parsing. A repeated object key: bass rejects it, and a JSON parser presents one value, so this schema never sees the repeat. An integer literal outside the signed 64-bit range or the unsigned 64-bit range: bass rejects that spelling, a JSON parser may widen it before this schema runs, and no maximum on one field covers every integer in the document. Nesting deeper than 512 levels: bass rejects it, and draft 2020-12 has no depth keyword. A serialized request that contains the bearer token: bass decide rejects it, the token is not a field of this document, and this schema is not given the token. bass decide --check applies the size, duplicate-key, integer, and depth rules. It does not apply the token rule, because it does not read the token.

model.description: Non-empty model name. bass imposes no maximum length and no character set.

additionalProperties.description: A question is a union discriminated by type: noul, choice, or score. Any other type is rejected.

oneOf.description: Yes-or-no question. criteria is optional. When present, true and false are non-empty strings. bass rejects an empty side, a missing side, null, and any other field. This object expresses those constraints.

criteria.description: From 2 to 255 options. Each property name is an option id of 1 to 100 printable ASCII characters, from space through tilde. The pattern is that rule. Every allowed character is one byte, so the pattern length matches the bass byte-length check.

From 2 to 10 non-empty strings, lowest first. bass preserves this order and does not check that the strings are ranked. JSON Schema cannot express that ranking either. The ranking is a meaning for the model, not a syntactic check.

questions.description: From 1 to 64 questions. Each property name is a question id.

propertyNames.description: 1 to 100 characters from ASCII letters, digits, underscore, period, and hyphen. The pattern is that rule. Every allowed character is one byte, so the pattern length matches the bass byte-length check.

state.description: Any JSON value except null. An integer literal in state is still subject to the 64-bit limit described on this schema, and state may be the value that exceeds the nesting limit. This schema does not state either check.

title: Decision request
